title: Big mansion?
content: This is one of my reccuring themes in my dreams. Not as prelevent as the others, but: Imagine a huge mansion, not neccessarily modern but very clear and luxurious. Building materials are wood, white shining kind of thing (like quartz in Minecraft) and there's a big courtyard too, the grass is cut short and is kind of darker. There's trees too. And there is forest far away. And what is most captivating is the vibe of those dreams.
